name: Galaxy Digital

logo.source: galaxy.com header icon (inline SVG, the Galaxy symbol); the site's 'galaxy' wordmark is live text, not an image; fill set to black

description: Galaxy is a crypto financial-services firm that also builds AI data centers. Almost all of its reported revenue ($60.4 billion in 2025) is the gross value of digital assets it sells while trading for clients; that is offset by almost the same amount of cost of those assets, so the real take is far smaller (revenue plus gains less transaction expenses was about $1.18 billion in 2025, computed). It earns spreads and interest on trading and lending, fees from advisory, asset management (ETFs and funds) and staking, gains and losses on its own crypto, and a bitcoin-mining sliver. The new leg is Helios, a West Texas campus converted from a bitcoin mine: it is leased to CoreWeave under a 15-year agreement (526 MW of critical IT load; the company puts total potential contract value at more than $30 billion including two five-year extensions), recognized its first lease revenue in Q2 2026, and is financed by $3.5 billion of 9.875% secured notes issued in July 2026. It lost $241 million in 2025 and $85 million in Q2 2026, hit by crypto-price impairments.

sub.name: Crypto exchanges, miners and bitcoin holders

hq.note: 300 Vesey Street (10-Q cover). Holding company: it owns Galaxy Digital Holdings LP (GDH LP), which runs the business, and shares economic interest with Class B holders. Listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange 2018 to 2026 and on Nasdaq since May 2025 (Q3 2026 investor presentation).

employees.note: '800+' employees (Q3 2026 investor presentation, 8-K exhibit 99.2). The FY2025 10-K said over 700 full-time employees at 2025-12-31, about 530 in the US. Both are floors, not exact counts.

businessLines.name: Digital Assets (trading, lending, investment banking, asset management, staking, custody)
businessLines.how: Takes the spread on principal trades and derivatives, earns interest and fees on loans, charges fees on advisory deals and management and performance fees on fund and ETF assets, and keeps a share of staking rewards; gross sales of crypto flow through revenue but are matched by cost.
businessLines.description: Global Markets (OTC spot and derivatives trading, lending, structured products, M&A and capital-markets advisory) plus Asset Management & Infrastructure Solutions (ETFs, alternatives, venture funds, staking on eleven networks, self-custody technology, tokenization). At 2026-09-30: 1,763 trading counterparties, average loan book $1.8B for Q3, $5.9B assets under management, $4.6B assets under stake, about $10B combined after overlap (Q3 2026 investor presentation). Launched GalaxyOne, a retail investing and deposit platform, in October 2025.

revenue.note: Gross revenue, mostly digital asset sales ($59,850.9M company-wide), offset by $60,108.6M of transaction expenses in the segment. FY2024 $42,497.1M. Q2 2026: $8,544.064M (digital assets sales $8,483.0M, fees $18.1M, blockchain rewards $17.5M, interest $24.8M) vs $8,655.7M.

businessLines.revenueNote: Gross revenue, mostly digital asset sales ($59,850.9M company-wide), offset by $60,108.6M of transaction expenses in the segment. FY2024 $42,497.1M. Q2 2026: $8,544.064M (digital assets sales $8,483.0M, fees $18.1M, blockchain rewards $17.5M, interest $24.8M) vs $8,655.7M.

operatingProfit.note: Segment net income (the CODM measure; no segment operating income reported), after $635.4M impairment of digital assets. FY2024 $47.0M. Q2 2026: $(19.048)M.

businessLines.name: Data Centers (Helios campus, West Texas)
businessLines.how: Long-term fixed-term lease of powered data-center space and infrastructure to CoreWeave, which pays rent as each data hall is delivered (base term of 15 years starts when the final hall is turned over); Galaxy is the landlord and borrows against the leases.
businessLines.description: Retrofitted bitcoin-mining campus in Dickens County, Texas leased to CoreWeave: Phase I 133 MW of critical IT load delivered in Q2 2026 (about 200 MW gross), Phase II 260 MW and Phase III 133 MW under lease, 526 MW in total (about 800 MW gross). ERCOT has approved 1,630 MW gross for the campus (3,600+ MW potential); 830 MW approved remains uncontracted.

revenue.note: FY2024 $0. Q2 2026: operator revenue $7.082M (including interest) plus first data-center leasing revenue $18.877M recognized in the 'revenues and gains' section, total $25.959M; Q2 2025 $0.

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $0. Q2 2026: operator revenue $7.082M (including interest) plus first data-center leasing revenue $18.877M recognized in the 'revenues and gains' section, total $25.959M; Q2 2025 $0.

operatingProfit.note: Segment net loss (CODM measure). Q2 2026 segment net income $31.155M, which includes a $32.45M income tax benefit (loss before taxes $(1.295)M); notes interest expense $7.365M.

businessLines.name: Treasury and Corporate (own digital assets, investments, proprietary mining)
businessLines.how: Gains and losses on holding crypto and venture investments, plus the small bitcoin mining operation (pays for power and hosting, receives block rewards); a cost center for corporate overhead and note interest.
businessLines.description: Galaxy's balance-sheet digital assets, venture, private-equity and fund investments, its remaining bitcoin mining, interest on notes, and unallocated corporate overhead. Net exposure at 2026-09-30: venture and fund investments $841M, bitcoin $538M, ether $128M, solana $108M, other tokens $77M, other liquid investments $25M (Q3 2026 investor presentation).

revenue.note: FY2024 $99.610M. Q2 2026 $6.190M (including proprietary mining $2.554M) vs $5.810M. Company-wide proprietary mining revenue was $14.5M in FY2025 (vs $63.3M in FY2024, -77%).

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $99.610M. Q2 2026 $6.190M (including proprietary mining $2.554M) vs $5.810M. Company-wide proprietary mining revenue was $14.5M in FY2025 (vs $63.3M in FY2024, -77%).

operatingProfit.note: Segment net loss: includes $118.3M digital asset impairment, $59.2M notes interest, $(35.5)M derivative loss; FY2024 net income $307.2M on $917.8M of gains. Q2 2026 $(97.423)M.
